name: DJ Valerie
reviewNotes:
Added because the venue calendar names her as the DJ for "Hosted by Valerie" dances; no website found.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Only a first name is published; no website, business Facebook/Instagram or DJ booking page was found. Her own ad in The Dance Calendar (Oct 2026, ad page 4) and the venue page give reservation phone numbers (one marked as a cell) and a personal-style Yahoo email for her dances; these look like personal lines, so they are NOT recorded here. If the owner wants a reservation contact, it may belong on the Waterfalls dance event/organizer entry rather than this DJ profile. The same Dance Calendar page 4 ad block mentions afternoon 'Autumn Dansants' and a Halloween Bash next to her contact line, but the PDF layout mixes several ads, so it is unclear whether those are hers; not used.
description: A DJ and dance host who plays ballroom and Latin dance music for the Saturday night social dances in the clubhouse ballroom at The Waterfalls in Lake Ronkonkoma.

evidence.note: The Waterfalls (55+ community, 400 Cassata Rd, Lake Ronkonkoma) lists 'DJ Valerie' for its ballroom dancing every 2nd and 4th Saturday, 7-11 PM, in the clubhouse ballroom.
Venue event calendar shows Ballroom Dancing with DJ Valerie on Oct 10 and Oct 24, 2026.
October 2026 Dance Calendar lists 'Ballroom & Latin Dancing at The Waterfalls Ballroom ... Hosted by Valerie', 7-11 PM, $20, with her ad on page 4.
